messages: Martha (People Ops): Quick heads-up: we've published two handbook edits (parental leave clarification + updated PTO accrual examples). Need everyone to e-sign the acknowledgement and complete a 15-min compliance microtraining by end of next week. :page_with_curl:; Sam (Manager): Thanks. Where's the ack link?; Martha (People Ops): DocuSign link is on the hub: https://hub.example.com/handbook/q2-updates. Also added a short FAQ doc for managers.; Asha (SWE): Are contractors required to sign the parental leave update? We have 3 temps on bench. ; Diego (HRBP): Contractors do not need to sign parental leave language unless they are on benefits or on a contract >6 months. Contractors with access to payroll systems must do the cybersecurity microtraining though.; Sam (Manager): Can you drop the CSV template for bulk manager enrollments? Saves me entering 40 rows. ; Martha (People Ops): Pasting header: manager_email,employee_email,employment_type,team,timezone,acknowledged_at,preferred_slot; Martha (People Ops): ```manager_email,employee_email,employment_type,team,timezone,acknowledged_at,preferred_slot```; Asha (SWE): For timezone mapping, is preferred_slot human-readable like "morn/eve" or an actual time?; Martha (People Ops): Use slot ids: MORN, MID, EVE. We'll map to local times automatically and include UTC mapping in the upload guide.; Sam (Manager): If someone contests the policy wording, who triages?; Diego (HRBP): Send me the ticket and label it policy-question. I'll coordinate with Legal and loop you in. We'll log exceptions in the tracker.; notify-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Handbook updates ack + microtraining" will post at T-72 and T-24; Martha (People Ops): Managers: do three things by Friday - 1) bulk upload your team CSV, 2) confirm e-sign invites sent, 3) check LMS completions. I'll export a summary on Monday; Asha (SWE): If a teammate misses the live slot, is the quiz enough to count as completion?; Diego (HRBP): Yes, recorded session + quiz qualifies. For regulated roles we require live attendance or 1:1 make-up. We'll flag those roles in the CSV; Sam (Manager): Uploaded my team's CSV and marked two on sabbatical as ON_SABBATICAL in employment_type. ; Martha (People Ops): Got it. I'll exempt ON_SABBATICAL entries from automated reminders. ; Asha (SWE): Cool. One more: do managers get a weekly digest of who still needs to sign?; Martha (People Ops): Yes, weekly digest every Monday 09:00 PT. Also exporting a compliance CSV: ```gsutil cp gs://redwood-ops/hr/handbook_q2_exports.csv ./handbook_q2_exports.csv```; Sam (Manager): Thanks, that'll help coaching time. ; Diego (HRBP): I'll pick up any escalations. Ping me directly if someone refuses to sign so we don't block payroll or onboarding.; Martha (People Ops): Final note: canned Slack reminder (copy/paste) coming in 30m for managers. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
